data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall recommendation is **1Password if ease of use is your priority, and Bitwarden if value for money is your priority.**

A business password manager should do more than store passwords. It should let staff securely share credentials, control who has access, and remove access immediately when someone leaves.

## My top 4 choices

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall for ease of use)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions.
- Easy for non-technical employees.
- Good admin controls and security reporting.
- Strong integration with business identity systems.

**Indicative price\:** US\$24.95/month for the 10-person Teams Starter Pack, or US\$8.99/user/month for Business.

Source: November 2026 pricing comparison. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cybercred.com.au](https://cybercred.com.au/articles/password-managers-compared-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[1Password website](https://1password.com/business)

---

![‎Bitwarden App - App Store](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/x38pyi5v1Vy6Zs97qz8ZgS0U3TY6bP46EZUol0vjWY-QJEsjpBL1sBYpo0AxExRZj59SXzc9D5J1hCMKpLCQRKtRmi0IYkc0CeiDQsrny4xPWuRz2OGsqZ9tyuMm4GtN5vMAwBBf6hXgHDHMP9_wXSBVttW9bXO5pQrWG4hhS-RxRNQIRTsbPrqb3y45Jv-M?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value for money)

- Open-source password manager.
- Shared collections for departments and projects.
- Admin controls and event logs.
- Good cross-platform support.

**Indicative price\:** US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

Source: [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Bitwarden website](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Business**

(Best for granular security controls)

- Detailed access permissions.
- Shared folders and secure file storage.
- Delegated administration.
- Good fit for compliance-conscious businesses.

**4\. Proton Pass for Business**

(Best privacy-focused alternative)

- End-to-end encrypted vaults.
- Secure sharing.
- Email aliases.
- Good option for privacy-conscious organisations.

**Indicative price\:** From around US\$1.99/user/month, depending on plan.

[www.openideurope.eu](https://www.openideurope.eu/reviews/password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[itsecureops.com](https://itsecureops.com/guides/small-business-password-managers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Proton Pass website](https://proton.me/business/pass)

## What I'd look for in a small business

Regardless of which product you choose, I'd consider these essential\:

| Feature | Why it matters |
|--------|--------|
| Shared vaults | Share company logins safely |
| Individual accounts | No shared master passwords |
| MFA | Protects access to the vault |
| Access permissions | Restrict sensitive credentials |
| Audit logs | Track account activity |
| Offboarding | Remove access when staff leave |
| Emergency recovery | Avoid losing company credentials |


One particularly important recommendation: don't let employees share company passwords through email, Slack, Teams or spreadsheets.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the right solution rather than simply the most popular one.

**1\. How many people are in your team?**
